en: I stood near the door yesterday.
I didn't stop at the red light.
You (m.) stood in front of the station for a long time.
You (m.) didn't stop at that roundabout.
You (f.) stood by the door of the house.
You (f.) didn't stop with your friend.
The bus stopped on time.
The taxi didn't stop here.
The girl stood next to my sister.
The car didn't stop at the stop sign.
We stood in the street waiting for the coach.
We didn't stop near the market yesterday.
You (pl.) stood in the line today.
You (pl.) didn't stop near the mosque.
The people stood in the street.
The police didn't stand in front of the house.
I always stand here every morning.
I don't stand in line.
You (m.) stand at that station.
Why don't you (m.) stop at the red light?
You (f.) always stand near the door.

lat: nti ma katweqfish f had l-blasa
en: You (f.) don't stop in this place.
The bus stops near the house.
He doesn't stand in the room.

lat: hiya katwqef f s-saff kul nhar
en: She stands in the queue every day.
Her car doesn't stop here.
We always stand near the café.
We don't stop in the middle of the road.
You (pl.) stand in this street.

ar: ما كتوقفوش مع الناس كل عشية
en: You (pl.) don't stand with people every evening.
They stop at the station every day.
They don't stop near the school at night.
Now I am going to stop near the bank.

lat: ma ghadish nwqef f had l-berd
en: I am not going to stand in this cold.

lat: nta ghadi twqef f r-ras dyal sh-shari3
ar: نتا غادي توقف فالراس ديال الشارع
en: You (m.) are going to stop at the end of the street.
You (m.) are not going to stop near the garage.
You (f.) are going to stand in front of the school.

lat: ma ghadish tweqfi f sh-shta ghedda
en: You (f.) are not going to stand in the rain tomorrow.
The taxi is going to stop for us now.

lat: huwa ma ghadish ywqef f t-triq
en: He is not going to stop on the road.
The teacher is going to stand near the table.

lat: hiya ma ghadish twqef qdam l-bab
ar: هي ما غاديش توقف قدام الباب
en: She is not going to stand in front of the door.
We are going to stop at the restaurant tomorrow.
We are not going to stop near the bridge.
You (pl.) are going to stop at the market.
You (pl.) are not going to stand here long.
They are going to stop near the sea.

lat: d-drari ma ghadish yweqfu f sh-shems
en: The boys are not going to stand in the sun.
